digest.component_or_area: automated bug filing subsystem across canary_bridge filers and reconciler conflict filer
propositions: Existing automated bug filers (heartbeat, binding-drift, conflict) lack standardized deduplication, resulting in duplicate tickets and spam when gate configurations or filer logic changes.
Heartbeat filer must implement a 2-consecutive-red threshold by querying the workflow's own run history to avoid filing on single flakes, with no new persistent state store.

All three filers must use stable dedup tags, templated bug bodies with required fields (check name, first-red time, run URL, failing output, workflow path), and abort-if-empty-detail with exit code 1.
Accumulation comment deduplication must enforce max one comment per target ticket per 24h by checking the ticket's own comment history for a marker line, not external state.

Conflict filer must extract to its own module with per-conflict sha1 dedup tag derived from local id + Jira key, and must not auto-close (requires adjudication), diverging from the canary filers' green-triggered auto-close pattern.
